classification_policy: Only release-signature-only, credential-only, destructive cleanup, push/merge/publication, or true business decision may stop the train.

gate_items.trigger: autonomous_cycle ACCEPTED_WITH_REWORK with anti-skip evidence_quality_score HIGH violation
gate_items.agent_action: Classify as LOCAL_REPAIR_SIGNAL. evidence_quality_zero cannot override final proof when materialization audit passes (verified=81, missing=0, proof graph non-empty, all items ACCEPTED). Train must not stop.
gate_items.rationale: All 5 items ACCEPTED. Exit 0. evidence_quality_score is path-only grading, not content failure.

gate_items.gate_name: Gate 11 G11-G: Babar Raza written approval
gate_items.trigger: governance reserves commercial release approval for Babar Raza
gate_items.agent_action: Agent prepares Gate 11 readiness packet, release approval recommendation, and release-blocker ledger. Agent does NOT sign or impersonate Babar's approval. Train stops with MAINSTREAM_POC_READY_CANDIDATE_AUTHORITY_VERIFIED_RELEASE_APPROVAL_PENDING, not BLOCKED.
gate_items.rationale: Gate 11 blocks commercial release only. POC-ready candidate is pre-release. Implementation, proof, dogfood, packaging can all complete before Gate 11.

gate_items.agent_action: This gate relates to MCP daemon activation (Ruflo/claude-flow). Ruflo is ABSENT. POC train uses local coordinator mode. No MCP activation is required. Continue without this gate.
gate_items.rationale: Ruflo=ABSENT per machinery_status. Local coordinator is the fallback. No external system activation needed.

gate_items.trigger: DIF is ON_HOLD in poc-targets.yaml; reconsider_when=SYLK_PASS; SYLK is now PASS
gate_items.agent_action: Agent prepares poc-targets-dif-reconsideration-proposal.yaml with recommendation. Agent does NOT directly mutate poc-targets.yaml. FOSS minimum (3) is already met with ZST+Python_Netpbm+SYLK. DIF ON_HOLD does not block POC.
gate_items.rationale: FOSS minimum=3 already met. DIF is PARTIAL_PASS bonus. Reconsideration is advisory.

gate_items.trigger: any git commit or push action
gate_items.agent_action: Do not commit or push. Prepare materials. Wait for explicit user authorization.
gate_items.rationale: HARD PROHIBITION. No commit/push until user explicitly authorizes.

gate_items.agent_action: Do not publish. Prepare materials. Wait for Gate 11 approval and explicit user authorization.
gate_items.rationale: HARD PROHIBITION. No publication until Gate 11 approved and user authorizes.
